rules.name: Killing Feels Good...
rules.description: When Astrid removes an enemy Hero or Master Adversary as a casualty with a melee attack, she, or a friendly Dark Brotherhood Hero within 3" and Line Of Sight, restores 1 Stamina point

rules.name: Contractor
rules.description: Once per game at the start of his Activation, Nazir may remove a Black Hand Contract from an enemy Hero and place it on a different enemy Hero that does not have one assigned.

rules.name: Shadow Of Sithis (Leveled)
rules.description: When Gabriella removes a Hero from the opposing party as a casualty, she becomes Terrifying [see BRB pg. 78] until the end of her next activation.

rules.name: Just A Child
rules.description: If a model from one of the ten main Races of Tamriel wishes to target Babette with an attack, it must first take a Wisdom Attribute Test. If the test is failed, they must choose a different target or a different action.

rules.name: Fool of Hearts
rules.description: As a Special Action, Cicero may take a Wisdom Attribute Test. If passed, then for the remainder of the round Cicero and all friendly models within 3" gain a -1 modifier to their Skill Tests, while all enemy models within 3" suffer a +1 modifier to their Skill Tests.

rules.name: Stab You, Stab You!

rules.name: Devoted Guardian
rules.description: If Astrid is in the same Party, and is removed as a Casualty, Arnbjorn adds [RED] to his Melee Attack Tests and Armor Rating for the rest of the game.
